node.title: Re: Downloading only new files added to a local path with Perl (FTP)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
epoch=$(perl -MFile::stat -e "print stat('$list')->mtime")

I would guess that $list contains special characters that are preventing correct interpolation. Try:

epoch=$(perl -MFile::stat -se 'print stat($list)->mtime' -- -list="$list") # or, better: epoch=$(perl -MFile::stat -wMstrict '-Mvars=$list' -se 'print stat($list)->mtime' -- -list="$list")

See [doc://perlrun] for the -s switch. Of course, the very best way is to rewrite your entire bash script as a Perl script. And why does your bash script start with use strict;? For bash scripts, see [https://vaneyckt.io/posts/safer_bash_scripts_with_set_euxo_pipefail/|Safer bash scripts with set -euxo pipefail].
